reviews.name: Austin Caldwell
reviews.text:
It’s not easy to describe the SYB Japan trip I just took, but to do so in one sentence is to say that it truly is lightening in a bottle - and something I definitely will keep with me my entire life.

I’d been a follower of SYB on Instagram for quite some time & finally decided to book my first by jumping on the ski trip to Japan, which was the second time it was run - but I truly would have never guessed. The execution of logistics, for starters, is unparalleled. Our trip leader, Sarah, left no detail unturned. From karaoke nights in Golden Gai in Tokyo, incredible museum visits at TeamLabs, to navigating the insane terrain of Niseko (on the mountain and in the town) - Sarah is a planning (& execution!) queen! Also - she’s just an all around badass - A+++ trip leader.

The destination & logistics are of course a big part of any SYB trip, but the real magic is in the people. From the welcome dinner, I felt immediate connections to people who I know I’ll call friends for life. People I cried to, people who picked me up (literally) when I fell in 5+ feet of powder, people who leaned in & also gave space for others on the trip, and people who were equally as okay with a long night out or a night in playing cards before an early morning of shredding - this all happened for me across the trip.

Book an SYB trip. It’s your best chance at capturing lightening in a bottle. Your only regret will be not booking one sooner.

reviews.name: Liat Abramove
reviews.text:
Probably one of the best experiences of my life. First trip was in Japan and knew I had to book another trip. Just coming off my second trip in Nicaragua. Such awesome vibes- workouts, great food and surfing.
Made some new friends and got some awesome pictures. Ive done some research with other companies and nothing is as legit as SYB. Can’t wait to head to Egypt in the spring!

reviews.name: Reg Godin
reviews.text:
My first Surf Yoga Beer to Niseko, Japan is hands down one of the best travel experiences I’ve ever had!

Everything was perfectly organized, allowing us to fully enjoy the legendary Japanese powder without a worry. Our leader Aaron knew exactly where to take us for the best runs, catering to all levels of skiers and snowboarders.

Beyond the slopes, the trip was packed with unforgettable Japanese experiences set up perfectly by Mantas, Steph and Sarah. After long days in the snow, we soaked in natural onsens, sang our hearts out at late-night karaoke, and indulged in some of the best ramen and sushi I’ve ever had!

The energy of the Surf Yoga Beer crew is next-level, creating an amazing group vibe from start to finish. Whether you’re looking to push yourself on the mountain, experience Japan in an authentic way, or just have an all-around epic time, this trip is a must. I’ll definitely be back for another round!
